name: application-connection-status-pill
title: Connection Status Pill
description: Live online/offline/reconnecting indicator with an animated pulse ring on the active state, for surfacing realtime connectivity distinct from static status badges.
useWhen: Showing the live state of a websocket, realtime sync, or collaborative session that can change without a page reload.
The connection state actively affects what the user can do right now (e.g. changes won't save while reconnecting).
Pairing a status label with a header, toolbar, or settings row for an at-a-glance realtime indicator.
avoidWhen: The status is static or set once per page load — use a plain badge instead, since the pulse animation implies liveness.
The state represents a resource's stored status (e.g. an order's shipped/delivered state) rather than an active connection.
responsiveBehavior: Both variants are compact inline-flex elements that size to their content; the header-row variant (variant 2) uses justify-between so it stretches to fill its parent width.
accessibility: Each pill uses role="status" so state changes (connected → reconnecting → offline) are announced to screen readers as they happen.
The animate-ping pulse ring is purely decorative reinforcement — the solid dot and the text label both independently convey the state, so the animation is never the only signal.
Color is never the sole indicator: each state has distinct text (Connected / Reconnecting… / Offline) alongside its color.

variants.title: All states
variants.description: Connected, reconnecting, and offline pills stacked to show the full state range
accessibility: Each state pairs a distinct color with distinct text, never relying on color alone.
